name: bundler
description: In-Wasm dependency bundler for the TS sandbox; runs in StarlingMonkey (no Node, no esbuild at runtime)

scripts.build: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -i build/bundle.js --initLocation http://bundler.localhost -o dist/bundler.wasm
scripts.build:debug: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -d -i build/bundle.js --initLocation http://bundler.localhost -o dist/bundler.wasm
